description.subtitle: Tarjeta Regalo de 80 euros en futbolmania
description.tagline: 80 euros para elegir el regalo perfecto
description.intro: The 80 euros football gift card allows you to give away football by letting the person who receives it choose what he really needs. With a value of 80€, it can be used both in physical stores and on the football website to buy among the products available.
key_benefits: Freedom to choose: The person who receives the card can decide on which products to use your 80€.
Flexible shopping: It can be used both in physical stores and in the online football store.
Regalo sin equivocaciones: Evita tener que acertar con la talla, el modelo o las preferencias concretas del destinatario.
For any footballer: A practical option to give away football material allowing each player to find what he or she is looking for.
